items.visualConcept: A municipal finance planning scene where several distinct revenue streams flow through historical records and economic signals into a multi-year forecast horizon, with uncertainty bands and scenario pathways.

A civic service system connecting public facilities and services to a transparent fee-policy framework: cost layers, service users, subsidies and affordability considerations represented without currency symbols or text.

A long-lived civic capital project balanced against a multi-year repayment path, existing obligations, future revenue capacity and policy guardrails, communicating capacity and tradeoffs rather than alarm.

items.topic: Debt service in a local government budget
items.visualConcept: A completed civic asset connected to a structured multi-year repayment schedule, with separate principal-and-interest paths and multiple legitimate repayment-source channels flowing into a public budget.
A coordinated portfolio of bridge, public building, road and utility assets organized around inspection records, lifecycle rings, maintenance intervals, renewal and replacement planning.
The same public asset shown across two points in time, with subtle condition decline, inspection records and accumulating maintenance needs, emphasizing planning consequences without dramatic decay.
